---
title: "docs(contributing): add a 'Your first contribution' section"
labels: ["documentation", "good first issue"]
---

**What's wrong**

`CONTRIBUTING.md` has dev setup and a "Good first issues" list, but no gentle, step-by-step
walkthrough for someone making their very first open-source contribution.

**Where to look**

- `CONTRIBUTING.md` — add a short "Your first contribution" section.

**Suggested fix**

A numbered list a newcomer can follow: comment to claim an issue → fork & clone → create a
branch → make the change → `npm test` / `npm run test:coverage` → open a pull request referencing
the issue (`Fixes #NN`). Keep it friendly and short.

**Done when**

- [ ] `CONTRIBUTING.md` has a clear "Your first contribution" section.
- [ ] Commands shown match the real ones in the repo (`npm test`, `npm run test:coverage`).

---

**New here?** This is a great very-first issue — you're documenting the exact path you just took.
Comment to claim it. Setup takes about five minutes — see
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/javvadivijayprasad/usagecontract/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
